event.title: SFSCON'26 - 'European SFS Award 2026' in Bolzano, Italy

body.p:
Each year during SFSCON, the European SFS Award is presented to recognize outstanding contributions to Software Freedom through Free Software.
Free Software Foundation Europe (FSFE) and Linux User Group Bozen-Bolzano-Bulsan assign the “European SFS Award”. The award is given to a person who contributed to the introduction of the culture of Free Software.
It will take place in the Seminar 1.
